score_contract.sort_contract: A selects the first maximum in original source order (idxmax semantics); stable timestamp then source ordinal ordering is used only for B/C; preserve row ID; no coordinate-line joining

score_contract.2026_scores: not present in identified work_008 cache; do not assume generated

score_contract.positive_floor_semantics: the score floor is an implementation detail; its accident-decision meaning, evidence basis, and data sufficiency remain unresolved

method_states.A: inherited_existing_baseline only; no recomputation in this worker
method_states.B: same anomalous segment containing A peak; onset timestamp
method_states.C: persistence check on exactly B's segment; if passes C=B, else persistence_not_met and no substitute time
segment_breaks: adjacent time gap > configured max_gap_hours; hourly max_gap_hours must be >0 and <=1 so an unobserved hourly bin cannot be bridged
method_states.ties_and_duplicates: A is the first maximum in original input order (idxmax semantics); sort by timestamp then original ordinal only for B/C; preserve duplicate rows and source IDs; identical same-time scores are allowed, conflicting valid or missing/valid scores return data_conflict / duplicate_timestamp_scores_conflict with A/B/C blank; count unique timestamps for persistence; duplicates do not imply elapsed duration
method_states.max_gap_policy: hourly input max_gap_hours must be greater than 0 and at most 1; values above 1 raise ContractError; no allowed value can join timestamps separated by a missing hourly bin

scope_limits: no external intake or v2 claims
